title: What is iterating, and why do it?

body.text: means refining a result over and over with follow-up prompts — like "make it shorter," "add an example," or "change the tone to formal." It works better than retyping a brand-new prompt each time.

example: "Great. Now add a call-to-action at the end of the article and make it more clickable."

title: Techniques for good follow-up prompts

body.text: states clearly what you want changed
instead of just saying "fix it." Say what to change, where, and why — e.g. "the second paragraph is too long, cut it to 3 sentences."

example: "Point 3 isn't clear yet — explain it with a real-life example and add one supporting statistic."

question: What does "iterate" mean in the context of using ChatGPT?
